title: If You Saved an Alien and Became Friends #shorts

lines.text: An alien just crash landed on your roof, and now it's staring through your window.
Don't scream. Offer it a snack. Pizza is risky, so start with an apple.
Next, teach it one word. Say hello slowly, and it will copy you, loudly, at three a.m.
Then show it Earth. Dogs, trampolines, and humanity's greatest invention, the blanket.
Soon it trusts you, and gives you a gift: a glowing rock that fixes your wifi forever.
But its ship is repaired, and it has to leave. It hugs you goodbye, and says its first word: friend. So, would you let it go?

sources: hypothetical comedy scenario, no factual claims
